methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page (apptweak.com/en/pricing, appradar.com/pricing, mobileaction.co/pricing, asodesk.com/pricing, sensortower.com/pricing, asolytics.pro/pricing/) plus WebSearch corroboration. All 7 drafted vendors exist and resolve; none fabricated; none removed. AppTweak and App Radar publish prices EUR-only (App Radar also bills USD at checkout but publishes no USD list); USD-equivalents are NOT officially published and are recorded as null with EUR amounts in notes - no USD figure was invented. AppFollow's pricing page is JavaScript-rendered and returned no content via WebFetch; Free $0 / Essential $179/mo / Team $599/mo were corroborated across softwarefinder.com plus WebSearch (Capterra/G2) and the vendor blog; a stale Capterra '$29/user/mo' figure was rejected. Sensor Tower publishes no self-serve prices (quote-only). TheTool.io 301-redirects to appradar.com and is not a separate vendor. Two corrections applied: Asolytics gdpr true->null (privacy page lists GDPR user-rights but makes no company-compliance claim); AppFollow compliance source repointed because the cited Data-Security support article returned HTTP 403 - SOC2/GDPR booleans retained as they were independently corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
